product.description: Stage Right™ by Monoprice™Memphis Blue Retro-Style Dynamic Vocal Microphone – Supercardioid, Pop-Free On/Off Switch, Protective CaseIconic Style, Focused Audio for Live Shows and Online ContentLook and sound the part with the Stage Right™ by Monoprice™ Memphis Blue Classic Dynamic Microphone. This retro-style, unidirectional vocal mic combines vintage aesthetics with a tight supercardioid pickup pattern that keeps the focus on your voice while helping to minimizing stage noise, crowd chatter, and room reflections. Ideal for live stages, karaoke, podcasts, streams, and hosted events where classic style meets modern performance.Behind the stylized shell is a well-engineered dynamic capsule housed in a rugged die-cast body with internal shock mounting to reduce handling noise and stand vibrations. A pop-free on/off switch lets you mute cleanly between songs or segments, and the mic connects easily to any standard XLR input.An included stand adapter and fitted protective case round things out, making it easy to set up, pack up, and take the Memphis Blue to rehearsals, gigs, and travel dates.
